extracted.name: Marshmallow Buttercream Frosting
extracted.description: This marshmallow buttercream is made with softened butter, confectioners' sugar, and marshmallow creme for a light, sweet frosting that’s easy to work with.
instruction_lines: Cream butter in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer on medium until butter is soft and fluffy. Gradually beat in confectioners' sugar, about 1/2 cup at a time; beat in almond extract. Gently fold the marshmallow creme into the frosting until thoroughly incorporated.
